main_body: desert building with flat roof, dome, and brick front wall
top_band: sandy tan flat roof with parapet and turquoise dome from row 3 to 33
evidence: Rows 3-33 clearly show the horizontal flat roof from above (with inner parapet walls casting top/left shadows at rows 5-30, a turquoise dome sitting on the roof, and a lighter front parapet edge at row 32). Rows 34-64 show the vertical brick front wall, beginning with a 2-row eave shadow (rows 34-35) and recessed door/window openings.

style.evidence: While the dome has 5-6 teal shading steps and the roof has some speckles, the brick front wall uses large uniform rectangular blocks (around 9x4 pixels each) that are mostly flat fills with only 1-2 stray pixels of variation, and wide 2-pixel flat mortar bands. Compared to the Beodeul reference buildings (intricate per-stone shading on house-h112_0-stone and detailed wood/plaster grain), the candidate's wall and door are much blockier and lower in tile information density.
